qt: to the Commission Alexander Jungbluth (ESN) Subject:
On 28 September 2026 the Budget Committee deliberated on buildings policy. The committee discussed, among other subjects, the extension of leases on the HELIOS and BECH buildings in Luxembourg. 1.
What is the general market rate for rent for comparable office blocks in Luxembourg as a whole, and in the district where the HELIOS and BECH buildings are located?
How much rent is actually paid for the HELIOS and BECH buildings?
